stories.title: Flintshire parents say children with additional learning needs are being failed
stories.summary: Parents of children with additional learning needs say the system in Flintshire is broken. The Local Democracy Reporting Service has received more than 20 case studies from across the county highlighting serious failings within the service. stories.title: Flintshire temperatures forecast to reach 30C on Wednesday
stories.summary: Temperatures in Flintshire are forecast to reach 30C on Wednesday, the hottest day of a week of building heat across England and Wales. stories.title: Bryn Williams team to run new daytime café at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A daytime café will open at Theatr Clwyd in Mold on Monday 24 August, run by the team behind the venue’s Bryn Williams restaurant. stories.title: Mold bus station users asked to avoid cordoned benches during works
stories.summary: Work has started on refurbishing the benches at Mold bus station, with only a small number taken out of use at a time so the rest stay available to passengers. stories.title: Plans to turn 197-year-old chapel into cottage submitted to Flintshire Council
stories.summary: A 197-year-old Wesleyan Methodist chapel in Flintshire may soon be transformed into a four-bedroom cottage. Seion Chapel in Lloc was originally built in 1810, but was rebuilt in 1829 in its current form.
